items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: and we got acts like Buddy Beans and Susan, Ella Fitzgerald on the same program.

ctx.x: bought another sleeper bus for the other band, had it made. That's the kind of money, man, it was. We all know Arlington Cemetery. He gave that land to the government and a lot of things like that.

He's dead, now. So I brought him up to meet Gail and he put all the money up. And that's the only way we got by the band, because I was paying $1,000 in those days, $2,000 worth of gals, with all that help. And then Ella was with the band a lot, and we got acts like Buddy Beans and Susan, Ella Fitzgerald on the same program. Had top acts with the band.
